blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Northern Mindanao — The main building of Iligan City Hall was illuminated in pink to raise awareness about the importance of early breast cancer detection and mental health care for women. The activity, which started on October 8, brought together the local government and community groups to encourage women to undergo regular medical checkup and prioritize their overall health. October is dedicated for breast cancer awareness throughout the world. According to World Health Organization, breast cancer is the most common cancer among women.
